meta.name: novel-game-analyze
meta.description: Deconstruct a novel for game adaptation. Compress a raw novel, deconstruction library, or writing project into a SOURCE_BIBLE with cited textual evidence, extracting world rules, player verbs, spaces, character will, systems, and visual anchors — without inventing a genre yet. Use for gameable book analysis, analyze a novel for game adaptation, extract game systems from a book. 游戏化拆书。把原始小说、拆文库或写作工程压缩成有必要原文证据的 SOURCE_BIBLE，提取世界规则、玩家动词、空间、角色意志、系统和视觉锚点，不提前发明游戏类型。用于游戏化拆书、分析小说的游戏改编基础等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把小说拆成可玩的游戏改编底稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手握小说素材,想评估或启动游戏改编。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a novel into a game adaptation blueprint
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a novel and want to explore or start adapting it into a game.

howto.what: 把小说或拆文库压缩成 SOURCE_BIBLE 文档，提取世界规则、玩家动词、空间、角色意志、系统与视觉锚点，并列出改编边界；不评价文笔，也不提前选游戏类型。
howto.when: 当用户要求对小说做游戏化拆书、分析游戏改编基础或从书中提取游戏系统时触发；需要提供原文或拆文库。

say.text: 请把这部小说拆成 SOURCE_BIBLE。
say.note: 会生成带证据的拆书文档。

say.text: 分析它的游戏改编基础，列出可玩动词和世界规则。
say.note: 输出提取维度与改编边界表格。

say.text: 从书中提取能做成系统的设定，附原文证据。
say.note: 会标注原作系统化程度与设计空白。

howto.what_en: Compresses a novel or deconstruction library into a SOURCE_BIBLE document, extracting world rules, player verbs, spaces, character will, systems, and visual anchors, and lists adaptation boundaries. It does not judge prose or select a game genre yet.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to deconstruct a novel for game adaptation, analyze a novel for game adaptation, or extract game systems from a book, and provides source material or an existing deconstruction library.

say_en.text: Please deconstruct this novel into a SOURCE_BIBLE.
say_en.note: A sourced deconstruction document will be generated.

say_en.text: Analyze its game adaptation foundation; list playable verbs and world rules.
say_en.note: Outputs extraction dimensions and an adaptation boundary table.

say_en.text: Extract settings from the book that could become game systems, with evidence.
say_en.note: Marks how systematized the original is and design gaps.
